In this video we cover:
IDFC First Bank ₹590 Crore Fraud Explained
IDFC First Bank disclosed a ₹590 crore fraud involving Haryana government-linked accounts at its Chandigarh branch. The issue came to light during account reconciliation, where balances did not match. The bank identified forged physical cheques and fake authorisation letters as the root cause—not a cyberattack
